connector.name: Personal Finance MCP
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted, read-only MCP server that connects your banks and investments via Plaid.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image personal-finance-mcp:1.0.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the josuem1109 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PLAID_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Your Plaid client_id from the Plaid dashboard (Team Settings -> API).

env.name: PLAID_SECRET
env.description: Your Plaid secret for the target environment (production or sandbox).

env.name: PORT
env.description: Port the MCP HTTP server listens on inside the container.
